mapper.delete: delete from STL_CASH_RECON where CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{execDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
delete from STL_SECP_RECON where CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{execDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
delete from STL_SEC_RECON_DEAL where TRADE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{execDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
delete from STL_SEC_RECON_DETAIL where SEQ_NO in( select SEQ_NO from STL_SEC_RECON_DEAL where RADE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{execDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and )
mapper.select: SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, PARA_CODE, PARA_VALUE, CONFIG_DATE FROM STL_SEC_RECON_PARA T1 WHERE PARA_CODE = #{RECON_PARA_CODE_02} AND CONFIG_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{execDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, MAX(CONFIG_DATE) CONFIG_DATE FROM STL_SEC_RECON_PARA GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID) T2 WHERE T2.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.CUSTOMER_ID AND T1.CONFIG_DATE = T2.CONFIG_DATE)
SELECT FINPROD_ID, ENTRUST_TRADE_ID FROM STL_SEC_RECON WHERE CHECK_RESULT = '1'

SELECT to_date(T1.SJRQ,'yyyy-MM-dd') cdate, T1.QMYE zybs, CASE WHEN T1.BZ = '0' THEN 'CNY' WHEN T1.BZ = '1' THEN 'HKD' WHEN T1.BZ = '2' THEN 'USD' END jylb, T2.ACCT_NO acctNo FROM INTERF_ZX_ZJYE T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 ON T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO = T1.ZJZH WHERE T1.SJRQ = #{execDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION ALL SELECT TO_DATE(T1.JYRQ, 'yyyy-MM-dd') cdate, T1.ZJYE zybs, CASE WHEN T1.BZLB = 'RMB' THEN 'CNY' WHEN T1.BZLB = 'HKD' THEN 'HKD' WHEN T1.BZLB = 'USD' THEN 'USD' END jylb, T2.ACCT_NO acctNo FROM INTERF_ZJYE T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 ON T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO = T1.ZJZH WHERE T1.JYRQ = #{execDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT to_date(T1.SJRQ,'yyyy-MM-dd') cdate, T1.CCSL amout, T2.ACCT_NO acctNo, CASE WHEN T3.FINPROD_ID IS NULL THEN T1.ZQDM ELSE T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID END marketId, CASE WHEN T3.FINPROD_ID IS NULL THEN T1.ZQDM ELSE T3.FINPROD_ID END finprodId, T3.CCY jylb FROM INTERF_ZX_GFYE T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 ON T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO = T1.ZJZH LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = CONCAT(T1.ZQDM,CASE WHEN T1.JYSC = '0' THEN '.SH' WHEN T1.JYSC = '1' then '.SZ' END) WHERE T1.SJRQ = #{execDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T1.JYSC IN ('0','1') UNION ALL SELECT to_date(T1.JYRQ,'yyyy-MM-dd') cdate, T1.DQYE amout, T2.ACCT_NO acctNo, CASE WHEN T3.FINPROD_ID IS NULL THEN T1.ZQDM ELSE T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID END marketId, CASE WHEN T3.FINPROD_ID IS NULL THEN T1.ZQDM ELSE T3.FINPROD_ID END finprodId, CASE WHEN T1.BZLB = 'RMB' THEN 'CNY' WHEN T1.BZLB = 'HKD' THEN 'HKD' WHEN T1.BZLB = 'USD' THEN 'USD' END jylb FROM INTERF_CCYE T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 ON T1.ZJZH = T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = T1.ZQDM AND T3.FINPROD_NAME = T1.ZQMC WHERE T1.JYRQ = #{execDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
